name: Project: Null point
detailed_description:
Note: Some of the features mentioned in this description are still not activated in the game or not visible because this version is only an incomplete trial version. The complete preliminary version will be released at the beginning of September 2025.

🌌 Project: Null point – Game Description

“What if your only way out… was buried deep in a world that wants you forgotten?”

Step into the void with Airlana: Nest of Silence, a hauntingly atmospheric 3D exploration game set in a colossal, shadow-drenched mountain world unlike anything you’ve ever seen.

You awaken inside a crash-landed spacecraft—no memory, no guidance, only a single objective pulsing through your mind: Escape. But the world outside is no sanctuary. Towering monoliths pierce the sky, ancient ruins whisper forgotten truths, and massive, biomechanical spider-like entities roam the land with predatory intent.

This isn’t just a hostile planet—it’s a nightmare constructed to be solved.

Navigate a surreal landscape where scale is distorted, and you are but a speck against an overwhelming environment. Scattered across the terrain are fragments of a long-lost puzzle—pieces that could unravel the truth of your presence here and the secret buried within the Nest of Silence.

But beware: pockets of deadly nuclear and acidic radiation seep from the earth itself, and silence is often broken by eerie echoes that suggest you're not alone. Every step deeper into the unknown peels back layers of a forgotten memory and leads you closer to one haunting question:

Are you here by accident… or by design?

🛰️ Key Features:

A vast, open-world mountain environment filled with towering anomalies and secrets.

Immersive atmospheric storytelling through environmental cues and visual symbolism.

Radiation zones, acid fields, and deadly creatures that test your survival instincts.

Puzzle-based exploration focused on memory recovery and unraveling a central mystery.

Unique aesthetic blending sci-fi, horror, and surrealism.

Explore. Survive. Remember. Escape.

The silence is not empty.

It’s waiting.

-----------------------

🚙 Your Vehicle. Your Shell. Your Last Line of Survival.

In Airlana: Nest of Silence, you are not a soldier. Not a superhero.

You are a lone survivor encased in a nuclear exploration suit, piloting a rugged, armored reconnaissance vehicle—your only companion in this vast, desolate world.

Built for the harshest environments, your vehicle is more than transportation—it’s your lifeline. Outfitted with military-grade shielding, it's capable of withstanding intense nuclear and acidic radiation, while also providing a high-tech array of tools, sensors, and survival systems:

Advanced Radiation Meters – detect invisible death before you feel it.

Environmental Audio Surveillance – pick up whispers in the silence.

Battery and Health Monitors – because here, power is life.

Radio Communications – tap into faint signals, possibly from others… or something else.

Classic Helicopter Drone System – deploy a compact aerial drone to explore unreachable peaks, deep valleys, or forbidden ruins on foot.

Stranded in a world that defies logic and scale, your vehicle is both armor and ally. But remember: some mysteries lie beyond the wheels. You’ll need to step out, face the unknown directly, and piece together the fragments of a forgotten truth.

-----------------------

🎮 Controls Overview (Updated Periodically)

Mastering your tools is the key to survival. Here are your primary controls:

🚗 Vehicle Controls:

Move: Arrow Keys or W A S D

Boost Speed: Shift

Brake: Space

🛠 Vehicle Systems:

Radiation Meter Toggle: R

Activate Radio System: Enter

External Camera View: 1 or F1

Interior Cockpit View: 2 or F2

🚶 On-Foot Exploration:

Exit Vehicle: 3 or F3

Re-enter Vehicle (when nearby): 4 or F4

🚁 Drone Deployment:

Launch Drone: 5 or F5

Ascend (Drone): Q

Descend (Drone): E

-----------------------

You’re not just exploring a world.

You’re navigating a riddle buried in silence, one system at a time.

Keep your gear running. Keep your wits sharper. And whatever you do—don’t let the silence consume you.

short_description: Project: Null point is a 3D exploration game set in a dark, vast mountain world. Pilot an armored vehicle, solve puzzles, avoid deadly radiation, and face strange creatures. Uncover hidden secrets and regain your memory to escape this haunting and mysterious place.
